==Description==
[[M-134]] is the fifth entity you will encounter within the M-Section. It was added in the first month of 2025 after a long wait for D-200's boss fight, and it acts as a relative, more dangerous twin to [[Claustrophobia]], as you'll see throughout this page. More information about [[M-134]] will be presented below.

==Appearance==
This section of the page has been divided into tabbers, or multiple paragraphs for mobile viewers. Despite [[M-134]] not having a history of designs yet, he has multiple forms that take on other appearances, which will be described here.

<tabber>
|-|Flame=
[[M-134]]'s flame appears to be an orange glowing light with firefly-like particles rising up, indicating fire. This is its idle state, and it will not change unless a behavioral state of the entity itself has changed, which will be described in the next section.
|-|Entity=
[[M-134]] appears to be a burning face with a completely burned side down the middle, where it shows another burned, melting eye. The other sides of its face appear to be actively burning, where the left side is burnt and crispy, with another eye that's normally hidden. The bottom half of the design features a screaming face with burned teeth and orange skin. It also appears to be actively melting or glitching away due to the black lines surrounding its jaw. It arguably looks similar to a burnt marshmallow, although with a creepy face charred into it.
</tabber>

==Mechanic==
M-134 will spawn in a random locker doing absolutely nothing. If a player quick enters/slams the locker that M-134 is inhabiting, the locker will explode and the player will be set on fire.

== Trivia ==
* '''M-134''' is the only entity that is just a '''Particle''' in-game ([[A-120]] no longer counts because it already got a redesign).
* '''M-134''', [[D-5]], and [[D-55]] are the only normally spawning entities from '''OG RFF''' that haven't gotten their Designs changed since they were first released
